question: Can a Qwen latent-memory mechanism consume a memory whose authoritative source is Aimee, with no representation of that memory in the model's textual context?
source: Actual aimee memory store followed by aimee memory get; synthetic research fact only
model: Frozen Qwen3.8-27B with the completed oracle-bf16-lr1e3 interface
core_test: Read actual Aimee record, select an exact-content-matched existing latent projection, and consume it without memory text. At least one paired success suffices.
optional_writer_test: Separately attempt a previously unseen value; writer failure does not decide source-consumption feasibility
trainable: Cached projection: none. Optional writer test: one 2048-dimensional external memory value; base and memory interface frozen
compiler: 240 fixed gradient steps, AdamW lr=0.001, no weight decay, FP32 parameter
source_value: Parsed exclusively from Aimee's read-back record, not supplied as a separate answer argument
training: Two fixed query forms; teacher-forced answer CE, no fact text in input prompt
evaluation: Six fixed unseen query forms; complete greedy answers, EOS required
evidence: Aimee record ID, store and content hash
compiled value artifact bound to source and model
exact prompt tokens and decoded text
answers with channel enabled and disabled
